notes.title: 1.3 Patch Notes | Season 1, Chapter 3
notes.notes:
[h2][b]New Battle Pass: Season 1, Chapter 3[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Unlock new rewards in the third Season 1 mini Battle Pass, including: -- 3 exclusive character skins -- 10 exclusive weapon skins -- An exclusive portal skin -- Multiple emotes, sprays, charms, player card banners, and player card titles -- 500 Splitcoin + 60 Proelium[/p][/*][*][p]The Premium Battle Pass will cost 500 Splitcoin (roughly $4.99 USD).[/p][/*][*][p]As a reminder, your Battle Pass tokens are not reset between Chapters. If you didn’t complete the Chapter 1 or 2 Battle Passes yet, you’ll still be able to unlock that content over the rest of the season.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]The Lab[/b][/h2][list][*][p]New customizable lights: Point Light and Spotlight[/p][p]Dev Note: More to come with skylight options soon.[/p][/*][*][p]New gamepad transform scheme for rotation, location and scale.[/p][/*][*][p]New customization options for weapon pads [/p][p]Dev Note: The tech developed for this will serve as a foundation for other map creator features down the line.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bugfixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where marquee selection wouldn't consider object groups[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where scaling an object wouldn't preserve the expected ratio if scaled from an axis[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where groups, prefabs and multi-selections would break a part on rotation/translation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the catalog text prompt would reset focus after searching an object[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Marquee selection is too sensitive.[/p][/*][*][p]Spectator mode doesn't currently work in map creator.[/p][/*][*][p]Players are sometimes not able to open their creations.[/p][/*][*][p]Desync issue where objects disappear present when players edit a map in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p]There are some focus issues present when using a gamepad.
[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="zYvMnpfElnA;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Community Update #2 | 7/18/25
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Splitfam, welcome to our first Community Update where each week we’ll be recapping news you may have missed, highlighting your creations, and letting you know about upcoming community events. Let’s get right to it.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]What’s New?[/b][/h2][previewyoutube="QkLcOfOM7vw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In our third Splitgate Weekly video, our Lead Game Designer Darek shared a preview of some upcoming balance changes as well as some perspective on his approach to balance in Splitgate 2. Make sure to share your own takes on game balance in the comments after hearing from him. Our team is still heads-down on a long list of fixes and improvements which you’ll be hearing more about soon.[/p][p]
We’re also continuing our regular player surveys and would greatly appreciate you taking the time to complete [url="https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/8389991/SG2-Weekly-Survey-7-14-25"][u]this week’s SG2 survey.[/u][/url][b] [/b]It won’t take long, we promise.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Map Highlights[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/97cc549e77e97be73dd52235bcfc0be2a809e5b8.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Club Silo [/b]by Ahayayeeti[/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] mmv-jrr-nz2[/p][p]Get ready to show off your moves in this incredible remake of Club Silo from Splitgate 1. The portal party never stops over here![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/45b2bad1eaf18aa5da2423f2cb248fadc999622b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Urban Flora [/b]by Je11y_thebro[/h3][p][b]Code: [/b]wk0-2qg-y3t
[/p][p]This space-themed urban garden from Je11y has clearly been tended with care. Don’t let the beautiful architecture and greenery fool you though, this is a chaotic battlefield that will put your portalling to the test.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/e30387780db30a794bcbf170e2d204e2f8ca1106.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Surf Slide [/b]by DubbleA302 [/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] in3-gwv-vmx
[/p][p]We mentioned recently that ice is now appropriately slippery across custom maps from the Lab, and DoubleA302 wasted no time taking advantage of that. Movement fans should definitely check this one out, just make sure to bundle up first.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/90efc6f5d6ef982d2d91e36f7f1843ff5142f501.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Whack-A-Mole [/b]by Jangutu [/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] sd5-rpj-uai
[/p][p]Looking to play something truly outside of the box? Jangutu has you covered and the setup is simple: grab a Deadbolt and tell your friends to start jumping. This is surely the pinnacle of aim training, no question.[/p][p]
Are you a certified Lab Rat with a creation worth showing off? [url="https://forms.gle/W7dfJWXGKAC3PbMD9"][u]Tell us about it through this form[/u][/url] so we can take a look for future weeks![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]MVP Spotlight[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/2eeae6f871d1ee167cfc95573ad13ec38578907b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This week we’re spotlighting our MVP [b]OmnicientWolf [/b]and asked him a few questions about him and his content!
[/p][p][b]Q: How did you first get into Splitgate?[/b][/p][p][i]I first got into Splitgate during the peak period where you had to often wait 3 hours in a login queue to get in due to the influx of players wanting to get in!  As a Halo fan, the idea of “Halo with portals” attracted me, and then once I started getting the hang of the portals, I was hooked!
[/i][/p][p][b]Q: How would you describe the content you make?[/b][/p][p][i]I mostly stream and create content around Splitgate 2 gameplay, whether that be messing around in socials or getting sweaty in ranked.  That being said, I also dabble in educational content, especially if I have a question that I’m trying to get to the bottom of myself!  I’m a strong believer in sharing your knowledge with people, so if that’s something that I can do, then hey, sign me up.
[/i][/p][p][b]Q: What modes do you play most often?[/b][/p][p][i]I’m definitely a 4v4 guy first and foremost.  I enjoy both social and ranked arena modes, so it really depends on what I’m feeling and who’s playing with me at the time.  In terms of specific playlist modes, I’ve always been a Team Deathmatch kind of guy, although I do enjoy Hot Zone quite a bit!
[/i][/p][p][b]Q: Where can people find you to check out your content?[/b][/p][p][i]My most active platforms are [url="https://www.twitch.tv/OmnicientWolf"][u]Twitch[/u][/url] and [url="https://x.com/OmnicientWolf"][u]Twitter[/u][/url] (or X, if you will).

Currently, I stream 3 days a week, Tuesdays – Wednesdays – Thursdays starting at 9 PM ET.[/i]
[/p][p][b]Q: Is there any content you’ve made that you’d like to highlight?[/b][/p][previewyoutube="kx5sKIg6SLw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]One of my first videos on Splitgate 2 was “3 Beginner Tips in 3 Minutes for Splitgate 2”[/i][/p][p]
[url="https://x.com/Splitgate/status/1943009005368152498"]https://x.com/Splitgate/status/1943009005368152498[/url][/p][p][i]One of my funnier posts is when the 1/200 chance to fart in-game had me chuckling, as featured on the Splitgate 2 socials.
[/i]
[url="https://x.com/OmnicientWolf/status/1942644859485184281"]https://x.com/OmnicientWolf/status/1942644859485184281[/url][/p][p][i]And another one is showing off the ability to shoot the splitball in Splitgate 2[/i][/p][p]
[b]Q: Anything else you'd like to say to the community?[/b][/p][p][i]I don’t think Arena Shooters get enough love in today’s day and age, so I do hope that the community can rally together and help shape Splitgate 2 to be the best that it can be.[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Events
[/b][/h2][h3][b]Space Man In-Game Event [/b](7/18-7/28)[/h3][list][*][p][i]Check out the new [b]Rapid Royale Zero G [/b]mode featuring Battle Royale combat with low gravity, Mythic weapons skins, and more! Unlock exclusive rewards by playing any game mode until the event ends.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Play Together [/b](7/18)[/h3][list][*][p][i]Interested in playing some Takedown with devs instead of hunting them down? Head over to [url="https://discord.com/invite/splitgate"][u]our Discord server[/u][/url] between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT today to compete for your chance to win Splitcoin prizes.
[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]GLHF and we'll see you back next week![/p]

notes.title: Community Update #1 | 7/11/25
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Splitfam, welcome to our first Community Update where each week we’ll be recapping news you may have missed, highlighting your creations, and letting you know about upcoming community events. Let’s get right to it.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]What’s New?[/b][/h2][p]Our Season 1 Chapter 2 update arrived with Ranked, Mastery Challenges, improvements to the Lab, and more. [url="https://www.splitgate.com/news/ranked-weapons-mastery-skins-have-arrived"]Check out the patch notes here if you missed them.[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="jsCnarFF-bo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]In our second Splitgate Weekly video, our co-founders Ian and Nick shared more information about what we’re working on and the team’s priorities for fixing the game.[/p][p]
We’re doing more to quantify your feelings on the game and make sure we’re moving in the right direction. If you haven’t done so already, consider filling out [url="https://survey.alchemer.com/s3/8380306/SG2-Weekly-Survey-7-4-25"]this week’s SG2 survey.[/url][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Maps Spotlight
[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/d3cbd1466ba166f914a7db1568719ef2edb28723.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Celerity [/b]by Code Phoenix[/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] my5-yne-imc
[/p][p]With creative launch pad positioning and great portal placement, Celerity is an absolute blast to fly through at top speeds. Takedown fans should definitely add this one to their rotation.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/0215250507451ef97fccdc6914bd6b3f966c3bc7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Atlantis SG1 Remake [/b]by ahayayeetu[/h3][p][b]Code: [/b]op3-ogs-aqr
[/p][p]Feeling nostalgic for some undersea action? Dive into this awesome remake of an SG1 classic. 
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/f037573f96588865f05516998461c677e8641abc.jpg"][/img][b]Don’t Fall / Only Up / Parkour [/b]by TTV:DjTyrannosaurusflex [/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] t0o-2fj-3ig
[/p][p]If you think you’ve mastered movement in Splitgate 2, it might be time to put your skills to the test in this wild parkour map. Be warned: you might end up testing your endurance more than anything else.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/19c9ac9b633bc7f46ffea33c8e74e0c38b7be69b.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Krusty Krab [/b]by AceBoogieJP[/h3][p][b]Code:[/b] 91g-u2y-tep
[/p][p]If you’ve ever wanted to live out your fry cook fantasies, we may have found the secret formula you’ve been looking for. Big Head Snipers on this map is a personal favorite over here.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/899d5aa372967e1733b7a7a06f3e810f89dbf8e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Interested in making your own unique maps in the Lab? There’s never been a better time with the recent introduction of Mirroring options, circular portal walls, the new Sandbox building set, the new Glacier biome set, and much more! 

Once your custom creation is ready to play, [url="https://forms.gle/W7dfJWXGKAC3PbMD9"]tell us about it through this form[/url] and you might see it featured in a future Community Update.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Splitgate MVP Highlights[/b][/h2][p]
Our Splitgate MVPs are always creating great content and this week was no exception.[/p][previewyoutube="d9Lb1YiGjAI;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="WvRha8Toyn8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Need some help getting your loadouts in order before starting the Ranked grind? Mikaveli and MayorReynoldsTV have you covered.
[/p][previewyoutube="8lM4n9qlQ9E;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Already have your gear in order and just want to watch some great Ranked matches instead? Check out Staycation’s latest video for a preview of what to expect.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Community Events[/b][/h2][p][b]4th of July [/b](7/4 - 7/18)[/p][list][*][p]The fireworks are still flying! You can unlock unique in-game rewards for free through next Friday by playing any mode or taking out enemies with the FUBAR power weapon.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Hunt The Devs [/b](7/11)[/p][list][*][p]Keep an eye out for aces with disco ball heads in Arena Quick Play! Our devs are going to be queueing up between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT today, and killing them will earn you one of three exclusive Dev Killer skins.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Play Together [/b](7/18)[/p][list][*][p]Interested in playing with devs instead of hunting them down? Head over to [url="https://discord.com/invite/splitgate"]our Discord server[/url] between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT next Friday to compete for your chance to win Splitcoin prizes. We’ll be playing our next featured game mode together and we promise it’s out of this world.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]As always, thank you for playing and for sharing your feedback with our team. We’ll be back with another hotfix next week and will have a lot more to share with you all very soon.[/p][p]GLHF this weekend![/p]

notes.title: Splitgate 2's first gameplay is here, and yep, adding classes changes everything
notes.notes: first look at Splitgate 2's gameplay shows off how the idea of an arena shooter, but with portals, is still just as wild and interesting a concept as when we first saw it. The 4.5 minute gameplay reveal features a few skilled streamers as they pour over Splitgate 2's combat, what sets it apart from the original Splitgate, and its three new classes—called factions...
